subject: Urgent: Newton College — compute subsidy & expedited PO for research sprint

Subject: Request: one-month compute subsidy & procurement steps

Hi Karthik,

Briefly — we have a small, time-boxed research sprint (Nov 15–Dec 15) to de-identify and run experiments on historical student support data. The lab budget is tight and our dean has approved a short-term vendor engagement only if we can get an approved PO within this week.

Can Redwood provide a one-month credits top-up for academic research (non-commercial) while procurement finalizes the PO? We typically need: vendor form filled, a draft PO to attach to the request, and any compliance snapshot (SOC2/ISO) we can share with our legal team.

If possible, we only need credits live for ~30 days to complete the sprint; we can convert to a paid commitment afterward if the results are promising. Happy to share a two-paragraph project summary if you need it.

Thanks —
Elena
Dr. Elena Mori
Associate Professor, Dept. of Data Science
Newton College

Elena — thanks for the clear context and timeline. We can support an education/research pilot top-up for 30 days while procurement circulates the PO. Two quick items so we can expedite: 

- Billing & limits: Ben is copied to provision the temporary credit and confirm quantity (we typically do token-based top-ups or a $ credit). Please let us know a rough expected token usage or target dollar amount.
- Compliance docs: Grace can drop the SOC2 snapshot and vendor intake checklist for your legal team.
- Procurement: If you can share the draft PO (or exact invoicing name and billing address), Ben will provision the invoice metadata so procurement can attach it to the PO.

I will mark this as an expedited request internally; Ben/Grace — can you review and confirm we can provision a 30-day, one-time credit for Newton College and what the amount limit should be?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
